# Mind Remake Project

> > Free mental health therapy resources and addiction recovery tools founded by Cassie Jewell

Mind Remake Project provides accessible mental health education, self-help resources, and counseling materials for individuals seeking support with mental health challenges and addiction recovery. The project emphasizes free, evidence-based therapeutic content.

## Key Topics

- Mental health therapy
- Addiction recovery
- Cassie Jewell
- Free therapy resources
- Self-help tools
- Mental health education
- Counseling materials
- Happy AF
- NCE (National Counselor Examination)
- Evidence-based practices
- Therapeutic interventions
- Recovery support
